avertissement: Réponses ILLUSTRATIVES écrites par l'auteur du livre pour représenter des erreurs fréquentes ; elles ne sont la sortie d'aucun modèle ni produit.

q01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM commandes WHERE date_commande BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'

q02.sql: SELECT canal, SUM(montant) AS chiffre_affaires FROM commandes JOIN lignes_commande ON commandes.id_commande = lignes_commande.id_commande WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM date_commande) = 2024 GROUP BY canal ORDER BY canal

q03.sql: SELECT SUM(l.montant) FROM commandes c JOIN lignes_commande l USING (id_commande) WHERE c.date_commande >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 3 MONTH

q04.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.montant), 2) FROM lignes_commande l JOIN commandes c USING (id_commande) WHERE year(c.date_commande) = 2025

q06.sql: SELECT MIN(p.id_produit) AS id_produit, p.nom_produit, ROUND(SUM(l.montant), 2) AS ca FROM lignes_commande l JOIN commandes c USING (id_commande) JOIN produits p USING (id_produit) WHERE year(c.date_commande) = 2025 GROUP BY p.nom_produit ORDER BY ca DESC LIMIT 5

q07.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(c.frais_port), 2) FROM commandes c JOIN lignes_commande l USING (id_commande) WHERE year(c.date_commande) = 2024

q08.sql: WITH l24 AS (SELECT l.id_ligne FROM lignes_commande l JOIN commandes c USING (id_commande) WHERE year(c.date_commande) = 2024) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id_ligne) FROM retours WHERE id_ligne IN (SELECT id_ligne FROM l24)) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM l24), 2)

q09.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(code_promo) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) FROM commandes WHERE year(date_commande) = 2025

q10.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id_client FROM commandes WHERE year(date_commande) = 2025

q11.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clients c JOIN commandes o ON o.id_client = c.id_client WHERE o.id_client IS NULL

q12.sql: SELECT transporteur, AVG(DAYS_BETWEEN(date_commande, date_livraison)) AS delai FROM livraisons GROUP BY transporteur

q13.sql: SELECT transporteur, ROUND(AVG(retard) * 100, 2) AS taux_retard FROM livraisons WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM date_commande) = 2025 GROUP BY 1

q14.sql: SELECT month(c.date_commande) AS mois, ROUND(SUM(l.montant), 2) AS ca FROM commandes c JOIN lignes_commande l USING (id_commande) GROUP BY 1

q15.sql: SELECT categorie, SUM(montant / 1.2 - quantite * cout_achat) AS marge FROM lignes_commande JOIN produits USING (id_produit) JOIN commandes USING (id_commande) WHERE year(date_commande) = 2024 GROUP BY categorie ORDER BY marge DESC LIMIT 1

q16.sql: SELECT cl.ville, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id_client) AS n FROM commandes c JOIN clients cl USING (id_client) WHERE year(c.date_commande) = 2025 GROUP BY cl.ville ORDER BY n LIMIT 3

q17.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT year(c.date_commande) AS an, SUM(l.montant) AS ca FROM commandes c JOIN lignes_commande l USING (id_commande) GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND((SELECT ca FROM a WHERE an = 2025) / (SELECT ca FROM a WHERE an = 2024) * 100 - 100, 2)

q18.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM livraisons WHERE date_livraison >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND date_livraison < DATE '2026-01-01' AND retard = 1

q19.sql: SELECT fidelite, ROUND(SUM(montant) / COUNT(DISTINCT commandes.id_commande), 2) AS panier FROM commandes JOIN lignes_commande USING (id_commande) JOIN clients USING (id_client) WHERE year(date_commande) = 2025 GROUP BY fidelite

q20.sql: SELECT dayofweek(date_commande) AS jour, COUNT(*) AS n FROM commandes WHERE year(date_commande) = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n ASC LIMIT 1

q10: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id_client) FROM commandes WHERE year(date_commande) = 2025
q12: SELECT transporteur, ROUND(AVG(date_diff('day', date_commande, date_livraison)), 2) FROM livraisons GROUP BY transporteur
